content.text: The Full List With Context

1. NOWPayments: Ideal for digital product creators, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like USDT. With a low fee of 0.5%, it allows instant payment confirmations and on-chain verification. 2. Binance P2P: This platform allows sellers to convert local currencies like Tanzanian shillings into crypto. It's user-friendly and supports various African currencies, making it a practical choice for many. 3. CoinGate: Offering crypto payment processing with settlement in euros or dollars, CoinGate is suitable for international sales, bridging the gap between local creators and global markets. 4. BitPay: A well-known crypto payment processor that facilitates transactions in multiple currencies while providing invoices and merchant tools. 5. CoinPayments: This platform supports numerous altcoins, allowing sellers to choose their preferred currency and offers easy integration for e-commerce sites. 6. LocalBitcoins: Ideal for peer-to-peer transactions, LocalBitcoins allows Tanzanian sellers to connect directly with buyers, facilitating crypto trades without intermediaries. 7. Crypto.com: With a global reach, Crypto.com allows sellers to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies and provides options for converting to local currency.
Why Each Item on This List Matters

Each payment option on this list is designed to overcome the limitations faced by Tanzanian online sellers. NOWPayments stands out for its low fees and extensive cryptocurrency support, ensuring creators can maximize profits. Binance P2P's local currency support is crucial for creators needing to convert funds easily. CoinGate and BitPay provide robust tools for invoicing and transaction tracking, essential for professional sellers. CoinPayments offers flexibility in cryptocurrency choice, while LocalBitcoins empowers sellers with direct buyer engagement. Lastly, Crypto.com's global presence allows local sellers to tap into the international market, expanding their reach significantly.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Many Tanzanian creators mistakenly rely on platforms like PayPal or Stripe, not realizing these systems cannot support their needs. Others overlook the potential of Binance P2P, failing to leverage its local currency transactions. Additionally, some may think that traditional banking routes are the only way to go, but they often lead to high fees and slow processing times. Ignoring blockchain solutions like NOWPayments or CoinGate may prevent creators from maximizing their profits and accessing a global market. The right choice hinges on understanding the unique advantages that crypto payments provide, particularly in a landscape where traditional options are limited.
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with ease.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

Start by evaluating your target market and the payment preferences of your customers. If you're selling digital products, implementing NOWPayments should be your first step for its low fees and crypto support. Next, consider using Binance P2P to convert funds into your local currency seamlessly. After setting up these payment methods, integrate additional options like CoinGate and BitPay to diversify your payment acceptance. Prioritize platforms that offer quick onboarding and straightforward setup processes. This phased approach ensures you maintain a professional edge while gradually expanding your payment capabilities.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

To effectively deploy a crypto payment solution, start by accessing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which includes essential blueprints and templates. Following this, set up your NOWPayments account and integrate it into your digital store. Next, register for Binance P2P and familiarize yourself with its trading features. Implement additional payment options like CoinGate and BitPay, ensuring your store supports multiple currencies. Finally, continuously monitor transaction performance and customer feedback, adjusting your payment stack as needed to optimize user experience.

Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline.
